answer: The admission burn is multiplied by 6 for each member already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. The nebula multiplier is published, charged in ridge, and vault lists each payment. A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, because the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. A farm of 4248 identities would post 4116 proofs and burn roughly 9 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
